items.Name: Silent Moves Leather Armor +2
items.Description: This powerful leather armor is expertly constructed and enchanted so that the wearer can move in almost complete silence.

items.Name: A History of Shadowdale
items.Description:
Shadowdale's origins can be traced back as early as 712 DR, The Year of the Lost Lance, the same year that the Army of Darkness began its assault on Myth Drannor, which led to that city's eventual ruin just two years later.

Lolth-worshipping drow took advantage of the fall of M…

items.Name: Astar's Half Plate
items.Description: Astar's armor is superbly crafted and enchanted to ward off the strongest blows.

items.Name: Belladonna
items.Description: Belladonna is a rare plant that seems to have an adverse effect on were-creatures. The plant is used like a potion and will temporarily protect the user from shapechanger attacks.

items.Name: Bitter Black
items.Description: Bitter Black is a stout beer exported from Arabel and sold through Aurora's Whole Realms Catalogue.
PropertiesDecoded: Alcohol, Beer Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Bittteroot
items.Description: Bitterroot is an edible herb with meaty thick leaves and light pink or white flowers. It can be used to brew beverages that often are an acquired taste and have a smoky flavor.

items.Name: Blood Apple
items.Description: Though not, in fact, made of blood, the apples of the blood tree cause an effect similar to a barbarian's berserker rage when eaten. This has resulted in unfortunate consequences when angry orchard owners have confronted groups of young scrumpers driven crazy by bloodlust.
PropertiesDecoded: Blood Frenzy (7) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Cormanthor
items.Description: Cormanthor was once called Arcorar (the Great King Forest), and was an immense woodland realm stretching to the Dragon Coast to the west and south, and over the Dragon Reach to the east. Many old elven kingdoms were found there, including Jhyrennstar, Rystall Wood, and Uvaeren, …

items.Name: Dragon's Breath Beer
items.Description: This beer has a strong and harsh flavor. It is best served with dark rye bread and Death Cheese.
PropertiesDecoded: Alcohol, Beer Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Drow Recall Stone
items.Description: This odd stone sphere is strangely heavy and has drow writing etched around the middle.

items.Name: Famous Citizens of Shadowdale
items.Description:
Shadowdale is notorious as a home for retired adventurers who now prefer the quiet life but are capable of exerting extreme force when necessary. Several of Faerun's most famous citizens now call the dale home.

Perhaps the most famous of all is the  Sage of Shadowdale himself, …

Immunity: Specific Spell Evard's Black Tentacles (7)

items.Name: Sapphire
items.Description: The blue sapphire is twin to the more precious ruby in all respects but color. In most stones, the sparkling blue color must be brought out by exposure to great heat. Once "cooked," the color change is permanent and does not otherwise affect the much-treasured durability of the …

items.Name: Zaertha's Note
items.Description:
Zaertha,
 
I have received news of a small elven patrol west of here, led by that fool Halinor. This, my dear, would be an opportune time to rid us of this nuisance once and for all. I will expect his head delivered to me by the end of tonight. 

The raid on Mistledale goes ahea…

items.Name: Thurbal's Key
items.Description: This key will open the door leading up to the second floor of the Twisted Tower.

items.Name: Weregund's Basement Key
items.Description: This key opens the door to the basement in Weregund's shop.

items.Name: Anabel's Cell Key
items.Description: This is the key to Anabel's cell on the subterranean level of Castle Krag.

items.Name: Jyordhan, the False Lord
items.Description:
Shadowdale has had the misfortune of enduring a few false lords during its tumultuous history, but none are as infamous as Jyordhan.

When Aumry was assassinated by Zhentarim agents in 1339 DR, Jyordhan captured and killed these assassins, claimed the Pendant of Ashaba, and pres…

items.Name: Elminster's Choice
items.Description: This dark beer has a thick head and is clouded with yeast. It has a smokey aftertaste due to its bitterness.
PropertiesDecoded: Alcohol, Beer Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Volo's Bestiaries: The Malaugrym
items.Description: The foul malaugrym were until recently thought to be the corrupt and tainted offspring of the wizard Malaug, reputedly the first human to explore the Plane of Shadow, preceding even the Netherese. However, that theory may have been incorrect, for the vile clan of shapeshifting c…

items.Name: Kella's Diary
items.Description:
This small diary contains several pages covered in neat hand-writing. You flick to a page near the back.

"...hopefully I should be feeling better by tomorrow morning. Old Hoareb really knows her stuff.

Looking forward to going back to work actually. Never thought I'd hear myse…

items.Name: Kella's Spare Key
items.Description: This is the key to Kella's house, in the south-east of town.

items.Name: Kerishnar
items.Description: The drow word 'Kerishnar' is etched along the shaft of this spear. The point of the spearhead is incredibly sharp, and will pierce through steel and bone as easily as flesh.

items.Name: Key to Armory
items.Description: This is the key Thurbal gave to you to unlock the armory.

items.Name: Kulnar's Ring
items.Description: This is the ring Kulnar gave you to present to Rast.

items.Name: Luck Blade +1
items.Description: This powerful blade seems to bestow great luck upon its wielder. Most weapons of this type have several inherent wish spells that can be called upon by the owner, but this particular blade's wishes have all been used up during its owner's long and illustrious adventuring career.

items.Name: Cloak
items.Description:
This black garment, embroidered with a web-like pattern in silk, gives the wearer many of the abilities of a spider.  The cloak also grants immunity to entrapment by web spells or webs of any sort.

Cloaks of this type are common in the Underdark, and are almost standard raiment…

items.Name: Cloak of Protection +2
items.Description: Cloaks of this sort are infused with protective spells, and are among the most popular and numerous magic items on the market. The original design may have originated in the earliest of arcane guilds, but the current makers of these items are varied and widespread.

items.Name: Map of Drow Camp
items.Description: This is a rough map of the camp and its surrounding area. There appears to be a secret route through the forest in the south-west corner of the camp, between two boulders. If this map is accurate, it should lead back to the same area of forest from which you teleported out of.

items.Name: Margblat's Head
items.Description: This is the head of the goblin leader, Margblat.

items.Name: Margblat's Journal
items.Description:
This appears to be a journal belonging to the goblin leader, Margblat. Though the handwriting looks like childish scrawl and most of the spelling is abysmal, much of it is legible. A few paragraphs are of interest.

"...Pah, stupide humans not now who does raiding. We takes cows…

items.Name: Masterwork Handaxe
items.Description: Masterwork items are extraordinarily well-made items. They are more expensive, but they benefit the user with improved quality. They are not magical in any way, although only masterwork items may be enchanted to become magical.

items.Name: Matron's Key
items.Description: This key has a very unusual design.

items.Name: Solar Armour
items.Description: Made from a fine silk, this robe seems to have a permanent aura of light around it.

items.Name: Mugwort
items.Description: Mugwort is a common fast-growing weed often disliked by farmers and gardeners, but useful to druids and potion-makers. Mugwort plants often grow back within mere days after being cut.

items.Name: Netherese Blast Sceptre
items.Description:
Netherese blast sceptres are powerful items dating back thousands of years to the time of Netheril, a powerful kingdom of human spellcasters wielding magic far greater than any seen today.

This particular sceptre can hurl bolts of chain lightning upon its owner's command. It ha…

items.Description:

items.Description: The master key to the upstairs guest rooms at the Old Skull Inn.

items.Description: These powerful potions imbue the drinker with great strength and fortitude.

items.Name: Red Nettle
items.Description: Red Nettle is a common edible plant found in the outskirts of the Dalelands that possesses curative properties and can be used as a material component.

items.Name: Ring of Minor Fire Resistance
items.Description: Under the direction of Druxus Rhym, these rings are created by the Red Wizards of Thay and are sold in their enclaves across the realms. Cheap and easy to make, this magical protection from certain elements is a huge source of profit for the enclaves.

items.Name: Ring of Spell Resistance
items.Description: This powerful ring emits a strong anti-magic field around the wearer.

items.Name: Rosemary
items.Description: Rosemary is a type of plant in the Realms that is primarily used as either a spice or a herb.

items.Name: Shadowdark Ale
items.Description: Shadowdark ale is brewed in Shadowdale with a dark brown cloudy bubbling appearance and a yellow foamy head.
PropertiesDecoded: Alcohol, Beer Cast Spell Single Use

items.Description: This key unlocks the gate dividing the bottom of the Sinkhole from the rest.

items.Name: Sulcar's Ring
items.Description: This simple band of gold is the wedding ring formerly belonging to Sulcar's wife, Gisella.

items.Name: Sylune's Amulet
items.Description: This amulet has an inscription that reads, 'To my heart, with all my love - Aumry.' It looks quite valuable.

items.Name: The Cult of the Dragon
items.Description: The secret society known as the Cult of the Dragon has existed in the Realms for over 400 years. The primarily human membership seeks to elevate evil dragonkind to rule all of Toril as its dominion. When possible, the Cult transforms powerful, willing evil dragons into dracolich…

items.Name: The Plane of Shadow
items.Description: It is the toxic plane of darkness and power. It is the hidden place that hates the light. It is the frontier of worlds unknown. The Plane of Shadow is a darkly lighted dimension that is both coterminous to and coexistent with the Material Plane. It overlaps the Material Plane mu…

items.Name: The Zhentarim
items.Description: The Zhentarim, also known as the Black Network, is an evil organization intent on dominating the land from the Moonsea to the Sword Coast North. Originally a secret society, for years the Zhents have operated openly around the Moonsea area, particularly around their greatest bas…

items.Name: Unsent Letter
items.Description: "Matron, I am pleased to report that the last raid on Battledale was a resounding success. We came upon them under the cover of darkness and set fire to their homes while they were sleeping. I believe we slew at least two-score of the humans, my Matron, although the few slaves w…

items.Name: Wand of Arcana
items.Description: This wand is a favourite of adventurers lacking in familiarity with the arcane. Useable by anyone, it enables the holder to understand the true nature of any magical object upon contact with the wand. It has limited charges, so the owner should be careful in how he employs this …
